description: This file provides function declarations and macro definitions for setting graphical parameters and styles in a Lua binding for a graphics library. It includes functions for background, fill, stroke, style stack management, shape alignment, and debug mode, with detailed documentation comments.

methods.name: background
methods.description: Sets or clears the background with a specified color, supporting multiple input formats such as RGB values, grayscale, color names, and hex strings.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Sets the fill color for shapes, supporting various input formats similar to 'background'.

methods.name: strokeWeight
methods.description: Sets the width of stroke lines in pixels.

methods.name: stroke
methods.description: Sets the stroke color for shapes, supporting multiple input formats.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Saves the current style and transformation state onto the stack.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Restores the previous style and transformation state from the stack.

methods.name: rectMode
methods.description: Sets the rectangle drawing alignment mode, such as CENTER, CORNER, or RADIUS.

methods.name: debugMode
methods.description: Enables or disables debug mode, often with 3D graphics support.
